To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1. the family centers are not a place of socialization for parents, but they are a place of social and educational support, 2. the family centers have the role of supporting and strengthening the parenting role, 3. the family centers should be a place where parents can meet, compare, share their problems and experiences, and find solutions, 4. parents are looking for a place to meet, to share their experiences and to find solutions to the problems they encounter, 5
the family centers are a useful tool to meet the needs of parents in the first years of parenthood.

parents are looking for support and help from professionals, but they also need the possibility to share with others, to have fun and play with their children, and finally to have a good and lasting relationship with the educators.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of parenting support and its effects on parents.
how the parents perceive parenting support services, in order to identify the real needs and expectations of the families and to develop an appropriate intervention.
the analysis of the needs of parents who attend a family center in the city of Verona.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

parents are looking for a place that allows them to feel at ease, to have fun, to learn to manage the educational relationship with their child, to have the opportunity to share with others and to be supported in their daily life.
the center for families has been able to meet the educational needs of parents, but it was not able to meet all the needs of parents, especially those related to social and relational needs.
the centers for families, are a place that allows parents to feel supported in their role as parents, in the educational and relational aspects.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the parenting support has to be considered in its complexity, as a multidimensional and multifaceted phenomenon.
the centers for families are a service that can help parents to build a network of social relationships, to acquire new knowledge, to learn new skills in the educational field.
parents are looking for a space where to find support in their parenting, where to learn how to be parents and where to meet other parents to share their experiences.
The main takeaway from our work is that
parents need support and guidance to help them in the process of parenting.
the parents need to have the opportunity to meet and talk to other parents, and to be able to talk about their children and their parenting.
the parenting support services should not be limited to a mere educational support but they should be a place where parents feel welcome and supported in the process of raising their children.
